characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: When a character fires a shotgun or blunderbuss at a target, any characters within one inch of th'e intended target could also be hit. Work out how many combat dice the character generates for their shot at the original target and roll that number of dice at both the intended target and any character within an inch of the intended target.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: When a character fires a shotgun or blunderbuss at a target, any characters within one inch of th'e intended target could also be hit. Work out how many combat dice the character generates for their shot at the original target and roll that number of dice at both the intended target and any character within an inch of the intended target.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: When a character fires a volley gun at a target, any characters within one inch of the intended target could also be hit. Work out how many combat dice the chawcter generates for their shot at the original target and roll that number of dice at both the intended target and any character within an inch of the intended target. A volley gun can break the cap of 5 dice in the shooting phase. See Shooting Phase on page I4.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: A character that moves into combat with an enemy character armed with a pike, lance, spear or whip must take a test. Use the character's Field Craft, requiring a six or more to be successful on a D 10. If the test is passed, the character managed to avoid the pike, lance, spear or whip on the way in. If they fail, they suffer a Fatigue Hit.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: A character that moves into combat with an enemy character armed with a pike, lance, spear or whip must take a test. Use the character's Field Craft, requiring a six or more to be successful on a D 10. If the test is passed, the character managed to avoid the pike, lance, spear or whip on the way in. If they fail, they suffer a Fatigue Hit. A character wielding a lance, spear or  whip has plus one Skill in the Combat Phase.

Use the character's Field Craft, requiring a six or more to be successful on a D 10. If the test is passed, the character managed to avoid the pike, lance, spear or whip on the way in. If they fail, they suffer a Fatigue Hit.  A character wielding a lance, spear or whip has plus one Skill in the Combat Phase.

rules.name: Alcohol
rules.description: Used to aid a wounded character by restoring fatigue. The wounded character can spend their activation drinking alcohol to aid their wound. Alternatively, they can interact with a wounded character to administer alcohol to the wounded man. In both cases use one of the character's Field Craft dice in the Recovery Phase. The wounded character heals D5 Fatigue Hits (i.e., a D1O result divided by 2, rounding up). Whomever consumes Alcohol counts as Distracted for the rest of the game. One use only. Loot.

rules.name: Bandages
rules.description: Used to aid a wounded character. They can in some small way aid a wound, the wounded character can spend any of their Recovery Phase Field Craft dice applying bandages to their wound. Alternatively, they can interact with a wounded character to apply bandages. In both cases use a Field Craft dice in the Recovery Phase. The wounded character heals DS Fatigue Hits. One use only Loot.

rules.name: Bugle or Drum
rules.description: Used to convey orders. A character can use this item in the Recovery Phase of the turn. They need a Field Craft test needing a 5 or more to be successful. If they pass the test, any character within six inches of them may add or deduct one from their Skill in the following turn.

rules.name: Camp Kettle
rules.description: Used by an unarmed character as an Improvised weapon. Alternatively, it could save a character's life. A character can ignore the first hit they suffer in the game if they roll a 6 or more on a D10. Loot.

rules.name: Chest
rules.description: A Chest can carry any number of coins that a group of characters have. One member of the group must carry the chest and they reduce their movement by one inch. Loot.

rules.name: Coins
rules.description: Each character can have several coins. They are used in several scenarios. One use only Loot.

rules.name: Friendly Dog
rules.description: This friendly animal aids the character in combat but hinders the character when he is hiding . Add 1 D10 to the characters Combat, this character cannot hide however. A player can place a Fatigue Hit on the friendly dog, removing it from the game, rather than taking a hit on the owning character. Loot.

rules.name: Grappling Hook
rules.description:
Used with a Rope to assist in the climbing of buildings. A character with a rope and grappling hook reduces the required score to 4+ when making a Field Craft test for climbing an obstacle over 2" in height. See High Walls
and Barriers on page 10. Can be used as an Improvised weapon by an unarmed character. Loot.

rules.name: Holy Icon
rules.description: Used to aid a character in times of need. A Character with a Holy Icon that is hit can save the hit on a six or more, when the character fails to save a hit with this item they loose their faith in it and it is useless for the rest of the game.

rules.name: Ladder
rules.description: Used by characters to scale obstacles and buildings. Loot.

rules.name: Lucky Charm
rules.description: Used to aid a character in times of need. A character with a Lucky Charm ignores the first hit on them in the game . Count it as a miss.

rules.name: Old Rattler
rules.description: The character gains a horse that they can ride. You must add the cost of a horse to any cavalry character. Loot.

rules.name: Pots and Pans
rules.description: Used by an unarmed character as an Improvised weapon. Alternatively, it could save a character's life. A character can ignore the first hit they suffer in the game if they roll a five or more on a D10. This character is very noisy though and cannot move when hiding. Loot.

rules.name: Provisions
rules.description:
Used to aid a soldier. Provisions can be eaten by a character in the Recovery Phase. Use a Field Craft dice, a character heals D2 Fatigue.(i.e., on a roll of 1 to 5 on a D10 they recover 1 and on a roll of 6 to 1 0 they
recover 2). One use only.

rules.name: Rope
rules.description: Used to tie up prisoners or used with a grappling hook to assist in the climbing of buildings. A character with a rope rerolls one of their Field Craft dice when making a Field Craft test for climbing an obstacle over 2" in height. See High Walls and Barriers on page 10. Loot.

rules.name: Snuff Box
rules.description: Used to provide solace to a soldier. A character with snuff can re-roll two dice over the course of a game when taking Field Craft tests. Loot.

rules.name: Standard
rules.description: Used to instill bwvery. Characters within ten inches of the character carrying the standard are immune to the Butcher's Bill result "Leg it" and "Get your Head Down. A command with a standard may reroll one Bled Dry dice roll. A command that loses their standard to the enemy through it being looted may never purchase another. The leader of the command also loses -1 Skill. Loot.

rules.name: Tobacco and Pipe
rules.description: Used to provide solace to a soldier. A character with these items can re-roll one die when taking a Field Craft roll once per game. Loot.

rules.name: Aggressive
rules.description: Red mist. This character gains +1 D10 to their Combat in the combat phase, but loses -1 D10 Field Craft to a minimum of 1 in the Combat Phase.

rules.name: Agile
rules.description: Light on his feet. This chqracter ignores the following Battle Events: Stampede, Insects and Soiled.

rules.name: A Good Sort
rules.description: loved and respected by his mates. Thus, his mates don't want to see him dead. One Character in the command has + 1 Skill. However, if this character is 'Defeated' the chosen charctcter is at -2 Skill.

rules.name: Bad Bargain
rules.description: Useless! The character rerolls any successful Field Craft rolls in the Recovery Phase.

rules.name: Brave
rules.description: Remains by the Colours to the end. Ignores the Butcher's Bill "Leg It!" result. Also, has +1 Skill in the Combat phase.

rules.name: Cook
rules.description: Great Stir about! This character has the skill to make anything taste good, thus, his mates don't want to see him dead. Whilst this character is alive your leader has +1 Skill, but if the cook dies your leader suffers -2 Skill.

rules.name: Coward
rules.description:
Disgusting article, a disgrace of a man. This character adds + 1 to the number required for a Recovery Phase roll from the
Butcher's Bill "Why do we kill one another?!", "Leg it!" and "Get ye head down!" results.

rules.name: Croaker
rules.description: I know my rights. This character has -1 Skill but they can re- roll unsuccessful Recovery Phase rolls.

rules.name: Cunning
rules.description: Knows when to strike. This character adds +1 to their Skill in the Combat Phase.

rules.name: Disfigured
rules.description: Terrible business there. This character has such horrible scars that any enemy fighting them in close combat counts as being distracted (re-roll one successful hit).

rules.name: Eagle Eye
rules.description: I see you! +1 Skill in the Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Fighting Villain
rules.description: This character cannot resist the chance to loot the injured and defeated. When a character is reduced to a Fatigue of one, or is defeated, the Fighting Villain ability comes into play; increase this character's Skill by 2 at this point.

rules.name: Giant of a Man
rules.description: Muscles, for a nick name, this one. A character with this trait adds +1 Fatigue and adds +1 D10 to their Field Craft when required to solve a problem using their strength.

rules.name: Glint in his Eye
rules.description: Skilled in looting. +1 D10 Field Craft when this character loots.

rules.name: Glutton
rules.description: Too many pies I am afraid: this character is rather overweight and suffers a minus two inch movement penalty and cannot sprint. This character also has +2 Fatigue.

rules.name: Good Climber
rules.description: Look at them go! Add  1 D10 to this character's Field Craft whenever they are required to take a test for climbing.

rules.name: Intelligent
rules.description: Knows how to work a situation. This Character adds + 1 to their Skill and adds + 1 D10 to their Field Craft when required to solve a problem using intelligence.

rules.name: Interrogate
rules.description: He will get it out of you. This character is a dab hand at getting information out of people - he adds + 1 D10 to his Field Craft when required to interact with Non Player Characters.

rules.name: Ladies' Man
rules.description:
Always has an eye for alady, any lady! This Character has + 1 Skill in the Movement Phase and Combat Phase in any
scenario involving a female NPC. However, the character always counts as distracted (re-roll one successful hit when shooting)

rules.name: Likes a Tipple
rules.description: Dutch courage and then some. This character likes a drink, stronger the better; he always counts as distracted and ignores the Butcher's Bill "Leg It" and "Why do we kill one another?!" results.

rules.name: Loathsome Individual
rules.description: Hated, but needs must in times of war. One other character in the command is at -1 Skill. If the loathsome individual is killed, then the chosen character gains +2 Skill.

rules.name: Lock Pick
rules.description: Gets where water cannot. This character can open most locks and disable traps; + 1 D10 Field Craft when solving a problem involving a lock or trap.

rules.name: Lucky Bugger
rules.description: How does he do it?! This character is classed as carrying the piece of equipment LUCKY CHARM.

rules.name: Not the Sharpest
rules.description: A bit dim witted. This Character deducts 1 from their Skill, and deducts -1 D10 from their Field Craft when required to solve a problem using intelligence.

rules.name: Rash
rules.description: Forward! + 2 Skill in the Combat Phase and -2 Skill in the Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Religious
rules.description: They will not loot a church. They gain the equipment item HOLY ICON.

rules.name: Runt of the Litter
rules.description: Quite a slender chap. A character with this trait deducts 1 from their Fatigue, and deducts -1 D10 to their Field Craft roll when required to solve a problem using their strength.

rules.name: Sawbones
rules.description: Keeps you on your feet. This character has had some rudimentary medical training. If they apply bandages in the Recovery Phase, they can add +1 to their Field Craft rolls, when doing so. If they don't have bandages, they can attempt to give first aid on a successful Field Craft test of six or more. If successful, they give a wounded character D2 Fatigue Hits back (roll a D10: on a 1-6 result they gain 1 Fatigue, on a 7-0 they gain 2) .

rules.name: Stalwart
rules.description: Has the heart of a lion. Ignores "Leg it!", "Why do we kill one another?!" and "I just Can't !"

rules.name: Strong Stomach
rules.description: Seen a few un-savoury things. This character can ignore the Battle Event "Soiled". They can also ignore an enemy character's Disfigured Trait.

rules.name: Sprinter
rules.description: Fast as lightning. This character can sprint twice per game.

rules.name: Tough
rules.description: Used to hardship and pain. +1 to recovery rolls, in the Recovery Phase, for injuries.

rules.name: Wits About Him
rules.description: I say Bravo old chap, bravo! This character has + 1 Skill in the Movement Phase, and -1 Skill in the Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Weedy
rules.description: He is always sick. -1 recovery rolls for injuries in the Recovery Phase.

rules.name: Armourer
rules.description: Knows what is required and when. Use this trait once per game to negate a damaged kit or avoid a broken weapon, see Butchers Bill table and Battle Event table.

rules.name: Back Stabber
rules.description: Sneaky! A character struck by this character must reroll one successful save.

rules.name: Bayonet Fighter
rules.description: A natural bayonet fighter. When fighting close combat using weapon with fixed bayonet this character gains an extra + 1 Combat D10.

rules.name: Brothers in Arms
rules.description: We have been through a lot together. During the shooting phase, one character within 6 inches of this character gains this character's 'base' Skill value.

rules.name: Carabineer
rules.description: A natural at loading a carbine in extraordinarily fast time, this character gains + 1 Field Craft D10 when rolling to reload a carbine in the Recovery Phase. Also gains equipment Carbine.

rules.name: Chosen Man
rules.description: Private or NCOs only. Choose to upgrade + 1 Skill, or + 1 Field Craft, or + 1 Combat.

rules.name: Cool in Action
rules.description: It is no thing that I have not seen before. -1 Skill in the Movement Phase and + 2 Skill in the Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Cool Under Fire
rules.description: Missed me! Once per game, this character can ignore the Butcher's Bill result "Why do we Kill one another?!" or "I just Can't".

rules.name: Decent Shot
rules.description: On his way to being a marksman. This character may reroll one missed hit in every Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Dirty Fighter
rules.description: Knows a trick or two. One enemy you are fighting in hand-to-hand combat counts as distracted times two (i.e. they must re-roll two successful Field Craft dice)

rules.name: Excellent Horseman
rules.description: Great rider. This character adds +2 to their dice rolls when taking Field Craft tests for a spooked horse and when crossing obstacles on horseback.

rules.name: Forager
rules.description: Where did that come from? This character has foraged a small farmyard animal that they have stuffed in their haversack. They may ignore the first hit they take on a 5 or more on a D10.

rules.name: Grenadier
rules.description: Back bone of the battalion. +1 Combat D10.

rules.name: Grumbler
rules.description: Seen it all. +1 Fatigue.

rules.name: Hero of the Empire
rules.description: Victory Laurels have graced me. This Character can make a free move at 0 Skill, over and above any other activation this turn. Character on foot only.

rules.name: Knife Fighter
rules.description: A dab hand with a knife. When throwing a knife in the Shooting Phase this character does not take the knife weapon modifier penalty. When fighting close combat using a knife, this character gains + 1 Combat D10. Gains equipment Knife, and has two knives.

rules.name: Lazy Soldier
rules.description: I will just hang back a bit. - 1 Skill.

rules.name: Light Infantryman
rules.description: A soldier who excels in the arts of skirmishing and making the best use of available cover. This Character gains + 1 Field craft D10 when being shot at. This character does not get an additional D10 if they were in cover (effectively, they always count as in cover).

rules.name: Looter
rules.description: Ah gold teeth . When another character is reduced to a Fatigue of one or is defeated the looter's ability comes into play and increase this character's Skill by one.

rules.name: Mannequin
rules.description: Devil of a business! This character has their move reduced by two inches. This character ignores "Leg it!" and "Get Your Head Down!" Butcher's Bill results.

rules.name: Marksman
rules.description: A keen eye. If this character hits and wounds an enemy character in the shooting phase, roll twice on the Butcher's Bill table and choose which single result to apply.

rules.name: Militiaman
rules.description:
I am no professional. This character must make a Field Craft test every time they receive a potential hit. The character needs to roll a three or more to be successful. If the Militia man fails, they run; the character must
retreat at Sprint speed towards their base edge. If in Combat, suffer one Fatigue Hit for each enemy character that they are in combat with. A Militiaman can have no other Battle Trait; if the character already has one they lose it.

rules.name: Musketeer
rules.description: A Natural at loading a musket in extraordinarily fast time - Field Craft +1 D10 when rolling to reload a musket in the Recovery Phase.

rules.name: NCO
rules.description: A good 'un too. This character increases their Skill and Field Craft by +1. (Not allowed on an officer character) .

rules.name: Pistoleer
rules.description: A Natural at loading a pistol in extraordinarily fast time.  Field Craft +1 D10 when rolling to reload a pistol in Recovery Phase. If an NCO or ordinary soldier, they gain the piece of equipment 'PISTOL'.

rules.name: Poor Horseman
rules.description: Donkey walloper. This character deducts -1 from their dice when taking Field Craft test for a spooked horse and when crossing obstacles on horseback.

rules.name: Pots and Pans
rules.description: A real Baillot that one. This character has placed his mess tin or cooking pot / camp kettle in just the right place and ignores the first hit that they receive .

rules.name: Pugilist
rules.description: Well landed Sir! This character can reroll failed to hit rolls in combat if fighting with their fists.

rules.name: Skilled With Sword in Hand
rules.description: When fighting close combat using a sword this character gains + 1 Combat D10. An NCO or ordinary soldier gains the piece of equipment Sword.

rules.name: Three Times a Minute
rules.description: This character has + 1 Skill in the Shooting Phase and -1 Skill in the Movement Phase.

rules.name: Veteran
rules.description: There's the danger. This Character does not have to shoot at the closest enemy character. They can pick any enemy character visible to them and within range of their weapon.

rules.name: War Face
rules.description: A character charged by a character with a War Face must pass a Field Craft test requiring six or more to be successful. A character who fails the test counts as distracted in the Combat. A Native American with this trait increases their opponent's Field Craft test to seven or more.

rules.name: A Natural
rules.description: See what he is doing there! The character generates an extra Skill pip that they can add to any character in their command. The Skill pip can be used on different characters each turn.

rules.name: Charismatic
rules.description: Forward boys! Characters within 6 inches of this character can ignore the "I Just Can't" Butcher's Bill result and take a Fatigue Hit instead.

rules.name: Country Gent
rules.description: Rifle Please!: This Officer comes with the equipment RIFLE and gains +1 Skill in the Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Dandy
rules.description: Watch my tights! . This officer suffers -1 Skill in the Combat Phase, but gains + 1 Combat D10.

rules.name: Disciplinarian
rules.description: What did you say?!. This Character has -2 Skill but the rest of his command gain +1 Skill.

rules.name: Duelist
rules.description: Engarde! This character must always accept a challenge and adds + 1D10 to their Combat in the Combat Phase when using a sabre.

rules.name: Flogger
rules.description: The lash for you! Any character in the command lose any negative trait. This character has -3 SkilL

rules.name: Get Forward
rules.description: Damn your Eyes! This character has -2 Skill in the Movement phase. The rest of their command has +1 Skill in the Movement Phase.

rules.name: Italian Bandit
rules.description: How many pistols?! This character has access to two extra pistols over and above any other weapons. Character gains two pistols.

rules.name: Lead From the Front
rules.description: Come on boys! This character gives +1 Skill to Characters within 12 inches in the Movement phase.

rules.name: Linguist
rules.description: Parley!. This officer can add 1 D10 to their Field Craft when required to solve a problem by talking with foreigners.

rules.name: Purchased Commission
rules.description: Daddy bought me this!. This character has + 1 Skill but the rest of his command has -1 Skill in the Movement Phase.

rules.name: Raised From the Ranks
rules.description: Will he get grudging respect. Before the Game begins make a test using this character's Field Craft dice requiring a single six or more to be successfuL If suc cessful, all characters under his command gain + 1 Skill in the Movement Phase. If the test is failed, then all characters under his command deduct -1 Skill in the movement phase.

rules.name: Regulations
rules.description: A stickler for the rules. This character has -1 Skill in the Movement Phase. Every other character in the command has + 1 Skill in the Movement Phase.

rules.name: Rich Boy
rules.description:
Money? No bother. This officer has the finest equipment, his sabre and pistol and long arm, if carried, are excellent pieces of work and are immune to being broken. If purchasing equipment, this character can purchase
an extra 3 points of equipment over and above the stated maximum in the scenario to be played.

rules.name: Rough Around the Edges
rules.description: Happy to talk with the lads. Before the Game begins make a test using this character's Field Craft dice requiring a single six or more to be successful. If successful, all characters under his command have + 1 Skill in the Combat phase.

rules.name: Slasher
rules.description: Have that you Bugger! This character gains +1 Combat D10 in the Combat Phase when using a heavy sabre. The officer comes with the equipment Heavy Sabre.

selectionEntries.name: Raise to Level 2 and add a Battle Trait
Add 1D10 to combat or increase Fatique by two pips
Raise to Level 3, Add a Personal or Battle Trait
Raise to Level 4, Add a personal or battle trait
Add 1D10 to combat, field craft or Increase Fatigue by three pips
